text.tspan: RehabFM hybrid pathway | Shared backbone and task-specific classifiers
Same H route: 22 external tasks + the in-house task
E1: remove conditioning information. E2: replace learned queries with official channel Transformer + masked mean.
Shared temporal weights process each modality separately. F statistics retain zero padding; std uses ddof = 0.
Panels A–D expand the main path; they are not extra stages. Interventions mark controlled tests, not demonstrated gains.
